exercises.title: Metaclasses: Basic
exercises.description: Create a class that modifies other classes.
exercises.context: Metaclasses are 'classes of classes'. They allow customizing class creation.
technicalNotes: Powerful but should be used sparingly

exercises.title: Asyncio: Event Loop
exercises.context: Asyncio is for concurrent network/IO bound code.
exercises.codeSnippet:
import asyncio
async def main():
    print('Hello')
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
    print('World')

asyncio.run(main())

exercises.title: Contextlib: ExitStack
exercises.description: Manage dynamic number of context managers.
technicalNotes: Perfect for managing variable list of files
exercises.codeSnippet:
from contextlib import ExitStack
with ExitStack() as stack:
    files = [stack.enter_context(open(f)) for f in filenames]

exercises.title: Type Hinting: Generic
exercises.codeSnippet:
from typing import TypeVar, Generic
T = TypeVar('T')
class Box(Generic[T]):
    def __init__(self, val: T): self.val = val
